learningObjectives: Connect interface screens into interactive user flows.
Use triggers and actions to simulate common interactions.
Create prototypes that communicate intended user behavior.

activities.title: Prototype Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of an interactive prototype.

content.concept: A prototype connects screens through triggers, actions, transitions, and destinations to simulate an experience.

activities.instruction: Match each trigger with the appropriate action.

content.concept: Triggers such as clicks, taps, hovering, and keyboard actions can initiate prototype responses.

activities.title: Prototype Flow Builder
activities.instruction: Connect screens to complete the user journey.

content.concept: Prototype flows model how users move between screens while completing a specific task.

activities.title: Transition Lab
activities.instruction: Select the transition that best fits each interaction.

content.concept: Transitions should reinforce the relationship between states without distracting users from their task.
